title: FoBounty
description: Let players put money on targets, hunt bounties, and claim Money rewards through a clean in-game bounty system using Vault.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/083e9338558f93882215dc06d8ff834b9d4aacad.png)
**Let players put money on targets, hunt bounties, and claim Money rewards through a clean in-game bounty system using Vault.**

FoBounty adds a player-driven bounty loop for survival, SMP, factions, and PvP servers. Players can set bounties with `/bounty add`, browse active targets in a GUI, track claim history, and get paid automatically when a bounty is claimed.

![Main bounty GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06d5c1a07192043de864acac168f0aef06a52264.png)

## Features
- Let players create bounties with server economy money through Vault.
- Pay killers automatically when they claim an active bounty.
- Browse active targets in a 54-slot GUI with bounty totals, contributors, pagination, refresh, search, and filters.
- Sort bounties by newest, oldest, highest, or lowest so players can find the best target quickly.
- Track claim and loss history in chat or a dedicated history GUI.
- Store active bounties, contribution data, earned totals, and history in SQLite.

![Showing lore of skull in GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b080c800da0b1b542501709c961283c110b72567.png)

## Admin Tools
- Edit key settings from an admin GUI, including min/max bounty price, natural death behavior, announcements, anti-abuse options, update checker, and history cap.
- Remove active bounties with an admin command.
- Reload `config.yml` and `message.yml` without restarting the server.
- Block suspicious bounty claims by same IP, same subnet, or same FoTeams team.

![Admin Editor GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/949fed249975fb20cee44e031106b367137d0cc2.png)

## Integrations
- **Vault** - Handles economy withdrawals and bounty payouts.
- **PlaceholderAPI** - Optional, adds placeholders for current bounty and total earned values.
- **Discord webhooks** - Optional embed notifications for bounty creation, admin removal, and bounty claims.
- **FoTeams** - Optional same-team claim blocking when FoTeams is installed.
- **SQLite** - Local persistence for bounties, contributors, earned totals, and history, shaded inside plugin, no need to add seperately.

![Discord Webhook Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4e42e17528dfae9daddf56a6e422f1c2c0c6d9d.png)

## Dependencies
- **Vault** and a Vault-compatible economy plugin are needed for bounty payments.
- **PlaceholderAPI** is optional for placeholders.
- **FoTeams** is optional for same-team claim blocking.
- Built for Minecraft server API `1.21`.

## Commands
- `/fobounty` or `/bounty` - Open the main bounty GUI.
- `/fobounty add <player> <amount>` or `/bounty add <player> <amount>` - Place money on a target.
- `/fobounty history [player]` or `/bounty history [player]` - View bounty history.
- `/fobountyadmin editor` or `/bountyadmin editor` - Open the admin editor.
- `/fobountyadmin remove <player>` or `/bountyadmin remove <player>` - Remove a player's active bounty.
- `/fobountyadmin reload` or `/bountyadmin reload` - Reload config and messages.
- `/fobountyadmin version` or `/bountyadmin version` - Show the installed plugin version.

## Permissions
- `fobounty.use` - Use player commands and the bounty GUI. Default: everyone.
- `fobounty.admin` - Use admin commands and admin tools. Default: operators.

Optional Discord webhooks, PlaceholderAPI placeholders, and FoTeams claim protection are available for servers that want more automation around bounty activity.

## Placeholders
- `%fobounty_total_earned%`
- `%fobounty_total_earned_formatted%`
- `%fobounty_current_bounty%`
- `%fobounty_current_bounty_formatted%`
